notes.text: Vincent Tang asked Jonathan Le on 1999-11-29 whether all vega positions are now captured in the database, since vega VaR will be implemented soon.
Jonathan Le told Vincent Tang on 1999-11-30 that vega positions are now being captured every day, but limited validation of vega is down.
Jonathan Le thinks Debbie Brackett and Rudi Zipter need to coordinate on the vega position validation issue. Ganapathy Ramesh, Grant Masson and Vince Kaminski were copied.
